parameters.query:
SELECT id, title, company, location, work_mode, url, match_score, matched_skills,
       missing_skills, red_flags, match_reasoning, score_confidence, language,
       cv_file_name, tailored_cv->'checks' AS checks
FROM jobs
WHERE status = 'tailored' AND cv_file_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY match_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
